scene: Pushing the round hatch opens onto the bustling Grand Transit Pier.
picture: Flat side-view across the busy waterfront platform. On the far left, a sleek pink bullet train hums with doors open. In the centre, you emerge on roller skates beside the open hatch. To your right, a golden dragon maglev idles on rails. On the far right, a suspended cable pod swings gently.

an ornate glowing dragon-headed train docked right of centre
